dropped.item: Exercises described as 'clear, easy-to-follow' and promise that 'you always know what to do and how to do it right'
Claim that Stepwise 'helps you stay consistent'
Reminders framed as keeping you on track
Progress sharing helps 'keep your recovery moving'

changed.item: Progress sharing: the original says the user chooses to share ('Let your physical therapist see'). The edit says 'Your physical therapist can see', which drops the sense that sharing is user-initiated or opt-in.

PT plan adjustment: the original says the PT can see progress 'so they can adjust your plan' (a possibility). The edit says the PT 'can see... and adjust your plan', which reads as a more direct capability.
